rules: Filter records where shipment_status is not active or pending; clamp delivery_date to within next 7 days; interpolate missing customer_id using last known value from prior record; all numeric values are rounded half away from zero with unit labels preserved; any field exceeding rate ceilings triggers a machine code error and halts processing.
invariants: Output must have exactly one address_origin field, all numeric values must be in specified units, and total shipment count must equal input record count after filtering; these are validated via a post-processing checksum that compares component totals against aggregate counts.
